descriptions.w3d_d26e_camera_axes_801a0cf4: Builds a camera's orthonormal axes: forward is eye minus target, normalized; side is the up vector minus its projection on forward. If that is degenerate, side falls back to the Y axis, then to the Z axis, each minus its projection; side is normalized, and up is side cross forward. Names are inferred from the arithmetic and from 0x801a1008, which reads these outputs.
